children: NN reported updated investor presentation noting raised 2026 guidance to $470M net sales midpoint and $60M adjusted EBITDA.
Posted updated investor presentation for Lake Street conference on Sept 10, 2026; presentation included as Exhibit 99.1.
2026 guidance raised: $470M net sales midpoint (range $460–$480M) and $60M adjusted EBITDA midpoint ($55–$65M).
2026 new business wins midpoint set at $100M (range $90–$110M), with $90M of wins through Aug 2026 noted.
Q2 2026 Y/Y: net sales +19%, adj. EBITDA +36%; first-half 2026 net sales $247.2M, adj. EBITDA $32.1M.
Scaling data center, defense, medical and electric grid markets: securing ~$47M awards in 2026 YTD and adding ~60 CNC machines in Wuxi for AI data center demand.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
